items.title: A Late Library Book
items.text:
A: Hello. I'm sorry, but I have to return this book late.
B: Thank you for bringing it back. It was due last Friday.
A: I know. My little brother spilled water on it, so I dried every page first.
B: I see. The pages look fine, so you don't need to pay anything.
A: That's a relief! May I borrow another one today?
B: Of course. And before you leave, look at the table by the window. Someone left a scarf there.
A: Oh, that's mine! Thanks for noticing.
B: No problem. Enjoy your new book.

qs.q: When was the book supposed to be returned?
qs.why: B가 'It was due last Friday'라고 말했으므로 반납 기한은 지난 금요일이에요.

qs.q: What will happen about the late return?
qs.why: B가 'you don't need to pay anything'이라고 했으므로 A는 아무것도 내지 않아도 돼요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, what does "relief" mean in "That's a relief!"?
o: A kind of help from a friend
A feeling of no longer worrying
qs.why: 걱정하던 일이 괜찮다는 말을 들은 뒤의 말이므로 '걱정이 사라진 느낌'이라는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does B mention the scarf?
o: To help A find something lost
To ask A to clean the table
qs.why: B는 창가 테이블에 두고 간 스카프를 알려 주어 A가 잃어버린 물건을 찾도록 도와요.

qs.q: What did A do before returning the book?
qs.why: A는 'I dried every page first'라고 하여 반납하기 전에 젖은 쪽을 말렸다고 말해요.

items.title: Planning the Class Picnic
items.text:
A: Our class picnic is next Thursday. Where should we go?
B: How about the riverside park? It has a big field for games.
A: Good idea, but we'd need a bus, and the bus costs money.
B: Then let's try the school garden. It's free, and there are tables there.
A: That works. What should we bring?
B: I'll make sandwiches. Could you ask everyone to bring a water bottle?
A: Sure. I'll write a note on the board after lunch.
B: Great. Let's hope it doesn't rain!

qs.q: What is the problem with the riverside park?
qs.why: A는 그곳에 가려면 버스가 필요하고 버스에는 돈이 든다고 말해요.

qs.q: Where will the picnic most likely be held?
qs.why: B가 학교 정원을 제안하고 A가 'That works'라고 동의했으므로 학교 정원에서 열릴 가능성이 높아요.

qs.q: What does "That works" mean here?
qs.why: 제안을 받아들이는 표현으로, '그게 괜찮은 방법이다'라는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does B say "Let's hope it doesn't rain"?
o: To ask for a new date
To show a worry about the weather
To say the tables are wet
qs.why: 비가 오지 않기를 바란다는 말로 날씨에 대한 걱정을 나타내요.

qs.q: What will A do after lunch?
o: Write a note on the board
qs.why: A는 'I'll write a note on the board after lunch'라고 말해요.

items.title: The Bike Repair Call
items.text:
A: Hello, bike repair shop. How can I help you?
B: Hi, I dropped off my bike yesterday. Is it ready yet?
A: Let me check. The new tire is here, but we're still waiting for the brake part.
B: Oh no. I need it for school on Monday.
A: I understand. The part should arrive tomorrow morning, so the bike can be fixed in the afternoon.
B: Can you call me when it's ready? I'll be at my grandmother's house today.
A: Sure. Please tell me your number again.
B: It's 555-0142.

qs.q: What is the shop still waiting for?
o: A tire for the front wheel
qs.why: A는 새 타이어는 왔지만 브레이크 부품을 기다리고 있다고 말해요.

qs.q: What can we guess about B?
o: B lives at a grandparent's house
B just bought a new bike
B rides the bike to school
qs.why: B는 월요일 학교에 가려면 자전거가 필요하다고 해서 자전거로 학교에 간다고 짐작할 수 있어요.

qs.q: What does "dropped off" mean in the dialogue?
o: Left at a place for someone
qs.why: 자전거를 어제 가게에 맡겨 두었다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does B say "I need it for school on Monday"?
o: To show the repair is urgent
To ask for a lower price
qs.why: 월요일에 필요하다는 말로 수리가 급하다는 것을 알려요.

qs.q: What will the shop do when the bike is fixed?
qs.why: B가 수리가 끝나면 전화해 달라고 했고 A가 'Sure'라며 번호를 물어요.

items.title: Finding the Museum
items.text:
A: Excuse me. Could you tell me how to get to the science museum?
B: Sure. Go out of the station and turn left at the bakery.
A: Turn left at the bakery. Then what?
B: Walk straight for two blocks. You'll see a tall clock on your right.
A: Is the museum near the clock?
B: Yes, it's just behind it. It's a gray building with a round roof.
A: Thank you so much. Is it a long walk?
B: Only about ten minutes. You can't miss it.

qs.q: How long is the walk to the museum?
qs.why: B는 'Only about ten minutes'라고 말해요.

qs.q: What can we guess about A?
o: A lives next to the bakery
A is late for a train
A does not know the area well
qs.why: A가 길을 묻고 있으므로 이 지역을 잘 모른다고 짐작할 수 있어요.

qs.q: Why does A repeat part of the directions?
o: To say the bakery is closed
qs.why: A는 'Turn left at the bakery'를 되풀이해 제대로 이해했는지 확인해요.

qs.q: What does "You can't miss it" mean?
o: It is not allowed to skip
It is too small to see
qs.why: 눈에 잘 띄어서 찾기 쉽다는 뜻의 표현이에요.

qs.q: What is the last landmark before the museum?
qs.why: 시계탑 바로 뒤에 박물관이 있다고 B가 말해요.

items.title: A Pet for the Class
items.text:
A: Do you think our class should get a pet?
B: I'm not sure. A pet needs care every day, even on weekends.
A: That's true, but we could take turns. A rabbit would teach us to be responsible.
B: Maybe. But what if someone has an allergy?
A: Good point. I hadn't thought of that. We could ask the teacher to check first.
B: Then I'd support a fish tank. Fish are quiet and don't cause sneezing.
A: A fish tank is a bit boring, but it's better than nothing.
B: Let's bring it up at the class meeting on Friday.

qs.q: What does B worry about first?
qs.why: B는 처음에 주말에도 매일 돌봐야 한다는 점을 걱정해요.

qs.q: How does A feel about the fish tank?
o: Not excited, but willing to accept it
qs.why: A는 조금 지루하지만 없는 것보다 낫다고 말하며 받아들여요.

qs.q: What does "bring it up" mean here?
qs.why: 회의에서 그 문제를 꺼내 이야기하자는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: What is A doing when saying "Good point"?
o: Agreeing that B raised a useful worry
qs.why: A는 B가 알레르기라는 중요한 문제를 말했다고 인정해요.

qs.q: What will the speakers do on Friday?
o: Suggest the idea at a class meeting
qs.why: 금요일 학급 회의에서 이 안건을 꺼내자고 B가 말해요.

items.title: Messages About Practice
items.text:
A: Where are you? Practice starts in ten minutes.
B: Sorry! My bus broke down, and we are all waiting on the road.
A: Oh no. Are you okay?
B: Yes, I'm fine. The driver says another bus will come soon.
A: Should I tell the coach you'll be late?
B: Yes, please. I think I'll arrive about thirty minutes after practice begins.
A: Okay. I'll go tell the coach now.
B: Thanks. Could you also bring my water bottle? It's on the bench.
A: No problem. See you soon!

qs.q: Why is B late for practice?
qs.why: B의 버스가 고장 나서 길에서 기다리고 있어요.

qs.q: What can we guess about the situation?
o: The coach is on the bus
qs.why: 'we are all waiting'이라고 해서 다른 승객들도 함께 기다린다고 짐작할 수 있어요.

qs.q: What does "broke down" mean in the dialogue?
qs.why: 버스가 움직이지 못하고 멈췄다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does A ask "Are you okay?"
qs.why: A는 B가 걱정되어 안전한지 묻고 있어요.

qs.q: What will A probably do right after this chat?
o: Tell the coach about the delay
qs.why: A는 'I'll go tell the coach now'라고 말해요.

items.title: A Laptop Problem
items.text:
A: My laptop won't turn on, and my presentation is tomorrow.
B: Did you plug in the charger?
A: Yes, but the little light doesn't come on.
B: Maybe the cable is broken. Try a different one.
A: I don't have another cable at home.
B: Then borrow the one in our classroom. Come early tomorrow.
A: Thanks. What if it still doesn't work?
B: You can use a school computer. Did you save your slides online?
A: Yes, I did. I can log in from any computer.

qs.q: What happens when A plugs in the charger?
qs.why: A는 충전기를 꽂아도 작은 불이 켜지지 않는다고 말해요.

qs.q: Why is A not too worried at the end?
o: B will give a new laptop
qs.why: 슬라이드를 온라인에 저장해 두었으니 어떤 컴퓨터에서든 로그인해서 쓸 수 있어요.

qs.q: What does "log in" mean in the dialogue?
o: Enter an account with a password
qs.why: 계정에 접속한다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does B ask about the charger?
o: To check for a simple cause
qs.why: B는 가장 쉬운 원인부터 확인하려고 충전기를 꽂았는지 물어요.

qs.q: What should A do tomorrow?
o: Come early and get the cable
qs.why: B가 교실의 케이블을 빌리라고 하면서 내일 일찍 오라고 말해요.

items.title: A Birthday Present Idea
items.text:
A: Grandma's birthday is on Sunday. Have you got a present yet?
B: Not yet. I thought about flowers, but they die so quickly.
A: How about a photo album? She loves old pictures.
B: That's a nice idea, but we don't have many printed photos.
A: We can print some at the shop near the park. I'll pay for the printing.
B: Really? Then I'll buy the album and draw a cover.
A: Perfect! Let's go to the shop after school on Friday.
B: Deal. And let's keep it a secret.

qs.q: Why did B not choose flowers?
qs.why: B는 꽃이 금방 시든다고 말해요.

qs.q: What can we infer about Grandma?
qs.why: A가 할머니가 옛날 사진을 좋아한다고 말해 앨범을 제안해요.

qs.q: What does "Deal" mean here?
qs.why: 계획에 동의한다는 뜻의 표현이에요.

qs.q: Why does A say "I'll pay for the printing"?
o: To offer help so the idea can work
qs.why: 사진이 부족하다는 문제를 A가 인쇄 비용을 대겠다며 도와 해결하려는 거예요.

qs.q: What will they do after school on Friday?
o: Go to the shop to print photos
qs.why: A가 금요일 방과 후에 가게에 가자고 제안하고 B가 동의해요.

items.title: Sorry About the Drawing
items.text:
A: I'm so sorry about your drawing. I didn't see the cup on the edge of the desk.
B: It's okay. Accidents happen. But I worked on it all weekend.
A: I know, and I feel terrible. Can I help you redraw it?
B: That would be kind, but the art show is on Wednesday. We don't have much time.
A: Then let's start at lunch. I'll bring my colored pencils too.
B: Thanks. Actually, only the corner is wet. Maybe I can save most of it.
A: Let me put it near the window to dry.
B: Good idea. Let's check it after class.

qs.q: When is the art show?
qs.why: B는 미술 전시회가 수요일이라고 말해요.

qs.q: How does B seem to feel?
qs.why: B는 사고였다며 괜찮다고 하지만 주말 내내 그렸다고 해 아쉬움도 보여요.

qs.q: What does "save" mean in "save most of it"?
qs.why: 그림의 대부분이 망가지지 않도록 지킨다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: What is A doing when saying "I feel terrible"?
qs.why: A는 실수에 대한 미안한 마음을 표현해요.

qs.q: What will they do after class?
qs.why: B가 'Let's check it after class'라고 말해요.

items.title: Choosing a Science Project
items.text:
A: We need to choose a project for the science fair. Any ideas?
B: What about testing which paper towel soaks up the most water?
A: That's simple, but many students did it last year. Let's try something different.
B: Then how about growing beans in different kinds of light?
A: I like that. We can put one pot in the sun and one in a dark closet.
B: We should measure the plants every two days and write down the numbers.
A: Right. I'll buy the seeds if you bring the pots.
B: Sounds fair. Let's start this weekend.

qs.q: What will B bring?
qs.why: A가 씨앗을 사고 B가 화분을 가져오기로 해요.

qs.q: What will the experiment probably show?
qs.why: 햇빛 아래와 어두운 곳에 둔 콩의 자람을 비교하므로 빛이 성장에 미치는 영향을 보여 줘요.

qs.q: What does "soaks up" mean here?
qs.why: 종이 타월이 물을 빨아들인다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does A say "many students did it last year"?
o: To give a reason for saying no
qs.why: A는 흔한 주제라는 이유를 들어 첫 번째 아이디어를 정중히 거절해요.

qs.q: What must happen before they can measure the plants?
qs.why: 식물을 재려면 먼저 씨앗을 심어 자라게 해야 해요.

items.title: Booking a Dental Visit
items.text:
A: Good morning, Hillside Dental Clinic. How may I help you?
B: Hello. I'd like to make an appointment for my cleaning.
A: Certainly. Are you free on Tuesday afternoon?
B: I have a piano lesson until four. Is there anything later?
A: We have an opening at five. Would that work?
B: That's perfect. The lesson is near the clinic, so I can walk over.
A: Please arrive ten minutes early to fill out a form.
B: Got it. Thank you.

qs.q: What does B want to make an appointment for?
qs.why: B는 'an appointment for my cleaning'이라고 말해요.

qs.q: When should B arrive at the clinic?
qs.why: 예약은 5시이고 10분 일찍 오라고 했으므로 4시 50분이에요.

qs.q: What does "opening" mean in the dialogue?
qs.why: 예약할 수 있는 빈 시간이라는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does A ask "Would that work?"
o: To check if the time suits B
qs.why: A는 제안한 시간이 B에게 맞는지 확인해요.

qs.q: What will B do first after arriving?
qs.why: A는 도착하면 서류를 작성해야 한다고 말해요.

items.title: At the Ticket Window
items.text:
A: Hi. I need two tickets to the lake town, please.
B: Round trip or one way?
A: Round trip. We'll come back tonight.
B: The last train home leaves at 9:15. Please don't miss it, or you'll have to stay overnight.
A: Thanks for the warning. How much is it?
B: Twelve dollars each. Children under ten ride for half price.
A: My sister is eight, so that's one full ticket and one half-price ticket.
B: Exactly. That will be eighteen dollars. Platform three, in fifteen minutes.

qs.q: How much will A pay in total?
qs.why: 어른 표 12달러와 어린이 반값 6달러를 합쳐 18달러예요.

qs.q: What can we infer about the travelers?
o: One of them is younger than ten
They live in the lake town
qs.why: A의 여동생이 8살이라 반값 표를 사는 것으로 보아 한 사람이 10세 미만이에요.

qs.q: What does "round trip" mean?
qs.why: 갔다가 돌아오는 왕복 여행이라는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does B mention the last train?
o: To warn A about the time
qs.why: 막차를 놓치면 하룻밤 묵어야 한다고 주의를 주는 거예요.

qs.q: What should A do next?
qs.why: B가 15분 뒤 3번 승강장이라고 안내해요.

items.title: Returning Shoes
items.text:
A: Hello. I bought these shoes last week, but they're too small.
B: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have the receipt?
A: Yes, here it is. I only wore them inside the house.
B: Thanks. They look new. Would you like a bigger size, or your money back?
A: A bigger size, please. I need them for the school trip on Saturday.
B: Let me check the storeroom. We have one pair left in your size, I think.
A: I hope so! I really like the color.
B: You're lucky. Here they are. Please try them on first.

qs.q: Why is A returning the shoes?
qs.why: A는 신발이 너무 작다고 말해요.

qs.q: Why does A choose a bigger size instead of a refund?
qs.why: 토요일 학교 여행에 신어야 해서 환불 대신 교환을 택해요.

qs.q: What is a "receipt"?
o: A paper that shows a purchase
qs.why: 물건을 샀다는 것을 보여 주는 영수증이에요.

qs.q: Why does A say "I only wore them inside the house"?
o: To show the shoes are not damaged
To ask for a lower price
To say the floor is dirty
qs.why: 신발이 거의 새것이라 교환받을 수 있음을 설득하려는 말이에요.

qs.q: What will A probably do next?
qs.why: B가 먼저 신어 보라고 하며 신발을 건네요.

items.title: Park Cleanup Plan
items.text:
A: Are you coming to the park cleanup on Saturday?
B: I'd like to, but I have a swimming lesson at ten.
A: The cleanup starts at eight and ends at eleven. Could you come for the first hour?
B: That should work. What do I need to bring?
A: Gloves and a hat. The club will provide the bags.
B: Great. Is there anything I should wear?
A: Old shoes, because the grass by the pond is muddy.
B: Okay. I'll ask my cousin to join us too.

qs.q: What will the club provide?
qs.why: A는 장갑과 모자는 가져오고 쓰레기 봉투는 동아리가 준비한다고 말해요.

qs.q: About how long will B probably stay?
qs.why: 수영 수업이 10시이고 A가 처음 한 시간만 오라고 해서 약 한 시간 머물 거예요.

qs.q: What does "provide" mean here?
qs.why: 동아리가 봉투를 마련해 준다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does A ask "Could you come for the first hour?"
o: To ask B to teach swimming
To find a way for B to join
qs.why: 수영 수업이 있는 B도 참여할 수 있도록 방법을 찾아 주는 말이에요.

qs.q: What will B do next?
qs.why: B는 사촌에게 같이 가자고 부탁하겠다고 말해요.

items.title: A Microphone Problem
items.text:
A: Can you hear me? I think my microphone is off.
B: I can see your mouth moving, but there's no sound.
A: Let me click the icon at the bottom. Is it working now?
B: Still nothing. Maybe you should check the settings.
A: Oh, I see the problem. Another headset was selected.
B: Great. Try again now.
A: Hello? Hello! Can you hear me?
B: Loud and clear. Now, shall we start the group talk?

qs.q: What was wrong with the microphone?
qs.why: A는 설정에서 다른 헤드셋이 선택되어 있었다는 문제를 찾아요.

qs.q: How are the speakers talking?
o: Face to face in a room
qs.why: B가 A의 입이 움직이는 것은 보이지만 소리가 없다고 해서 화상 통화임을 알 수 있어요.

qs.q: What does "Loud and clear" mean?
qs.why: 소리가 잘 또렷하게 들린다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does B say "Maybe you should check the settings"?
o: To ask for a new mic
To suggest a way to fix it
qs.why: 클릭해도 소용이 없자 B가 해결 방법을 제안해요.

qs.q: What did A do before checking the settings?
qs.why: A는 먼저 아래의 아이콘을 눌러 보았고 그래도 안 되자 설정을 확인했어요.

items.title: Planting the Garden
items.text:
A: Why are you putting the tomato plants by the fence?
B: They need lots of sun, and that side of the yard gets light all afternoon.
A: Makes sense. What about the lettuce?
B: I'll plant it under the tree. Lettuce burns in strong sun.
A: Won't the tree's roots take the water?
B: That's possible. So I'll water the lettuce a little every evening.
A: Let me help. I can carry the water cans.
B: Thanks. Could you bring the small shovel first?

qs.q: Why does B plant the tomatoes by the fence?
o: That spot gets sun all afternoon
It is far from the tree
qs.why: 토마토는 햇빛이 많이 필요하고 그 쪽은 오후 내내 햇빛이 들어요.

qs.q: What can we infer about lettuce?
o: It grows better in some shade
qs.why: 강한 햇빛에 상추가 타므로 그늘이 있는 곳에서 더 잘 자란다고 추론할 수 있어요.

qs.q: What does "take the water" mean here?
o: Use up the water for themselves
qs.why: 나무뿌리가 물을 흡수해 버릴 수 있다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: What is A doing with "Won't the tree's roots take the water?"
qs.why: A는 상추가 물을 못 얻을까 봐 걱정을 제기해요.

qs.q: What will A do first?
qs.why: B가 먼저 작은 삽을 가져와 달라고 부탁해요.
